text:
nora: Quick consolidation from the postmortem (PM-2026-052). Root cause summary: LB reconcile thrash + DNS cache shadowing + TLS handshake retries amplifying client retry traffic. Posting owners and short ETAs so we can track remediation.

ops-bot: Postmortem recorded: PM-2026-052 https://redwood.internal/postmortems/PM-2026-052 :spiral_note_pad: 

brett: I'll own the reconcile guard. Plan: add a compare-and-swap on route applies and a temporary stop-reconcile toggle for canary pools. Mitigation ETA: 2026-06-14 16:00 UTC.

ashok: I'll take DNS invalidation. Action: reduce canary flip TTL to 15s and add event-driven invalidation + metric dns_shadow_count. ETA: 2026-06-14 18:00 UTC.

sam: TLS owner: region-2 saw handshake spikes during rotation. I'll add jitter to rotation, tighten cert cache invalidation, and reduce max concurrent handshakes. ETA: 2026-06-15 12:00 UTC.

leo: I'll run the verification probes after mitigations. Probe command I'll use:
```
curl -sS -H "Host: api.redwood.internal" https://lb-probe.local/check -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}
"
```
Posting CSV to PM-2026-052.

nora: Action list for JIRA (confirm owners):
- ACTION brett: CAS + stop-reconcile toggle  ETA 2026-06-14 16:00 UTC
- ACTION ashok: TTL reduce + invalidation events + dns_shadow_count metric  ETA 2026-06-14 18:00 UTC
- ACTION sam: rotation jitter + cache tightening + handshake cap  ETA 2026-06-15 12:00 UTC
- ACTION leo: probe matrix + verification report  ETA 2026-06-14 23:00 UTC

brett: small note: will short-circuit reconcile after 3 rapid retries to avoid thrash.

ops-bot: Follow-up sync scheduled: 2026-06-15 09:00 UTC.

brett: Update 2026-06-14 15:45 UTC: CAS merged to canary, deploying now.

ashok: Update 2026-06-14 17:20 UTC: TTL and invalidation hook pushed to canary; dns_shadow_count dropping from ~30/min to ~4/min.

sam: Update 2026-06-15 11:40 UTC: rotation jitter and handshake cap rolled to region-2; early telemetry shows handshake retries down ~70%.

leo: Update 2026-06-14 23:30 UTC: probe matrix complete. No asymmetric routing observed; attached CSV to PM-2026-052.

nora: Thanks everyone. I'll create the grooming ticket for longer-term prevention (control-plane rate limits, retry dampening heuristics) and close follow-ups once all verification artifacts are in the postmortem. Reopen here if any regression. :white_check_mark:
